title: Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Nitrogen Metabolism Research Network
summary: This cluster revolves around Saccharomyces cerevisiae, a yeast organism, and its involvement in nitrogen metabolism. The yeast has conserved cellular pathways with humans and has genes and metabolisms related to nitrogen metabolism. Researchers Gao Xiaoli, Zhang Shengwei, and Ge Shanshan contributed to the conceptualization, data curation, and formal analysis of the yeast's pathways. The study also involves metabolomics data, which is related to both genomics and proteomics methods. Additionally, the yeast's mitochondrial dysfunction and retrograde signaling are linked to nitrogen metabolism.
